title: Online Scams: The Shady World of Fraudulent Investment Sites
desc: Using software from a company in Israel, scammers reel in gullible investors and steal all their money. DER SPIEGEL dove deep into this world of greed-fueled criminal networks - and found a hero.

title: The Future of Europe: Canada in the EU Sounds Crazy. Is It?
desc: The European Union needs new momentum. Canada needs a reliable partner. It would be a stretch for the EU to expand across the Atlantic, but doing so would be beneficial for both Europe and Canada.

title: Fake Jewish Lineage: The Passport Scheme that Exploited Germany’s Nazi History
desc: DER SPIEGEL has learned that a large number of fraudsters have obtained German citizenship by claiming to be the descendants of Jews persecuted by the Nazis. The real families are furious.

title: BYD, Geely, Xpeng: Germany’s Vaunted Auto Industry in Dire Straits Amid Chinese Surge
desc: The numbers of Chinese cars on European roads is skyrocketing as carmakers from the People’s Republic rush to build factories in the EU. Germany’s traditional brands are struggling to respond.

title: Amodei vs. Altman: How the Race for AI Dominance Is Increasing the Risks
desc: Anthropic founder Amodei and OpenAI CEO Altman once worked together to build a Super AI. Now, they are competing to be first. And that race is proving dangerous.

title: Boats from Eastern Libya: How Europe Is Bowing to a Libyan Warlord on Migration
desc: Brussels is concerned about the rising number of migrants reaching Crete - and is allowing itself to be blackmailed by the notorious Haftar family in eastern Libya, as DER SPIEGEL reporting has found.
